bank_rate_percent.source: RBI homepage (Bank Rate shown as 5.75% as at 1:00 pm on 16 Oct 2026) | https://www.rbi.org.in/ | Dated circular: RBI/2026-27/282, 7 Oct 2026 (repo 5.50%, MSF 5.75%) | https://rbi.org.in/SCRIPTS/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63742
bank_rate_percent.note: The RBI homepage shows the current rate and will change; the dated circular is the fixed citation. The circular does not itself state the Bank Rate — the homepage does.

registration_must_predate_supply.source: CONTESTED. Silpi Industries v. KSRTC (29 June 2021, 2021 SCC Online SC 439) held registration is prospective. NBCC (India) v. State of West Bengal (10 Jan 2025) questioned that position and noted registration is discretionary for micro and small enterprises. Not settled law — agent must not state it as a rule.

eligible_activities.source: UNVERIFIED. Act defines 'enterprise' to cover manufacturing and services; 'supplier' also names bodies selling goods made by small enterprises. The trading exclusion comes from a Ministry memorandum that has not been located. Do not use until the Ministry notification is confirmed.
